response.sql: WITH telescope_weather AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_group_modindex FROM telescope_weather) SELECT tw.weathprofile, AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(tw.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(tw.avg_modindex - b.mean_group_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline FROM telescope_weather AS tw CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE tw.avg_modindex > b.mean_group_modindex GROUP BY tw.weathprofile;
